slides.texte_overlay:
rules i follow so i never
feel awkward in public

no sorry, but

i stopped starting sentences with sorry, but. asking a question or taking up space isn't a mistake, and people take you more seriously the moment you drop the apology.

an exit line ready

i keep one easy line ready to end any conversation kindly, like it was great to catch up. knowing you can leave at any time makes it so much easier to start talking.

head up, not down

when i walk into a room, i look up and around instead of down at my phone. a raised head takes two seconds and makes you look like you were always meant to be there.

one good story

i learn one good story every day in 5 minutes: a myth, an invention, a strange moment in history. a good story is the easiest way into any conversation, with anyone.

laughing at the stumble

when i trip over my words or spill something, i laugh first. people only remember awkward moments when you act ashamed of them, never when you shrug them off.
